    OnlyDeepNode from the core case of [mild] #

    [mild] Lemma 2.1 and duality (RayCat.MildContour.deep_of_contour) reduce Bongartz's Theorem 3 ("contours of a minimal representation-infinite ray category are deep") to the core case (ρ = π(y) factors through the last arrow of v) for the small ray category P of B and for Pᵒᵖ (OnlyDeepCoreNode); MildHyp passes to Pᵒᵖ (RayCat.MildHyp.op). Through the bridge from the reversed ray paths (RayCat.toP) this gives OnlyDeepNode (onlyDeepNode_of_core).
